mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_webchat_message ( tenant_id, conversation_id, visitor_id, client_message_id, message_type, content, direction, sender_type, status, error_message, agent_user_id, source, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{visitorId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{direction}, #{senderType}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{agentUserId}, #{source}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, now()), #{updateTime} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, conversation_id, client_message_id) WHERE client_message_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, conversation_id, visitor_id, client_message_id, message_type, content, direction, sender_type, status, error_message, agent_user_id, source, create_time, update_time FROM crm_webchat_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
